unit_cost_assumptions.range_method: lower/expected/upper use min/mean/max observed costs from the 20 base preflight_record requests. Intervention replay has no measured live artifact, so replay estimates transfer this base-generation request unit as a proxy.
unit_cost_assumptions.key_row_extra_request_formula: extra_requests = 2 * key_row_span_count beyond the standard 3 repeats, because key-row sensitivity requires 5 repeats per selected key-row span; no key rows are selected in this planning-only audit.

full_400_original_generation_cost.policy: one accepted original trace per manifest row

preflight_total_amortized_envelope_not_r.note: This envelope carries the 23/20 preflight attempt multiplier, including determinism probes. It is not the stochastic route original-generation policy.

full_400_stochastic_intervention_replay_.basis: Observed preflight traces contain 20 spans across 20 evaluated records. Replay cost is not measured; this is a proxy estimate from base generation request cost.

expected_runtime.basis: Sequential requests; no route-specific wall-clock measurement exists. Range uses 5-20 seconds per request and 45-second configured timeout ceiling.

scale_estimates.claim_allowed_if_pass: Engineering smoke only: request-shape feasibility, rough cost confirmation, and preliminary replay-agreement diagnostics under disclosed drift.
scale_estimates.claim_forbidden_even_if_pass: No task-specific v2 pass, no global v2 pass, no deterministic replay claim, no full-generation-ready claim, no causal claim, and no PRM/filtering claim.

scale_estimates.claim_forbidden_even_if_pass: No task-specific v2 pass, no global v2 pass, no deterministic replay claim, no full-generation-ready claim, no causal claim, and no PRM/filtering claim.

minimum_viable_scale.smoke_minimum_for_budget_learning: 20 samples, 80 core API requests, expected cost USD 1.16018; this is not reviewer-viable validation.
minimum_viable_scale.reviewer_viable_minimum_for_configured_g: 400 samples, 1600 core API requests, expected cost USD 23.2036; this is the first scale that can satisfy 190 valid traces and 150 eligible spans per task if data quality holds.
minimum_viable_scale.cost_ceiling_assessment: The top-tier candidate expected and observed-max proxy costs are below USD 150, but scientific risk remains high because preflight drift and Delta-U sparsity are unresolved.

reviewer_risks.why_it_matters: The current preflight status is PREFLIGHT_FAIL_DRIFT, so deterministic replay and deterministic full-generation wording are forbidden.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_or_stop: Disclose drift, use repeated replay plus sample-level bootstrap only after explicit budget approval, and stop if replay agreement is too low.

reviewer_risks.why_it_matters: Sparse or zero-inflated intervention utility can make rank metrics unstable even if traces and replay rows are complete.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_or_stop: Require at least 20 nonzero Delta-U rows per task; otherwise stop as insufficient_target_variation.

reviewer_risks.why_it_matters: GSM8K and HotpotQA exact-match outcomes can be brittle, especially under paraphrase or alias variation.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_or_stop: Report appendix metrics where preregistered, keep exact-match fragility as a limitation, and do not upgrade claims if target variation is inadequate.

reviewer_risks.why_it_matters: A pass on one task cannot imply global support across GSM8K and HotpotQA.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_or_stop: Evaluate task-specific gates separately and permit only heterogeneous/task-specific wording unless both tasks pass.

reviewer_risks.why_it_matters: Provider model behavior and missing system_fingerprint metadata can shift between preflight and any later budget-approved run.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_or_stop: Log API date, endpoint, model, fallback, service tier, request parameters, response IDs, SDK/transport version, and drift disclosure for any future approved run.

reviewer_risks.why_it_matters: Smoke and 100-sample pilot scales are cheaper but cannot satisfy the preregistered per-task coverage gates.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_or_stop: Use smaller scales only for feasibility; do not claim validation unless the full configured coverage and rank-signal gates pass.

reviewer_safe_stop_conditions: Current state: do not run any API; next_allowed_step remains STOP_AND_FIX_PREFLIGHT.
Any API execution requires a separate explicit stochastic validation budget approval; this audit is not approval.
Any manifest overlap is a hard stop before scoring, replay, or reporting.
Any target leakage or post-hoc weight/threshold change is a hard stop.
Schema success rate below 0.95 or tag extraction success rate below 0.95 is a hard stop.
Replay success rate below 0.85 is a hard stop.
Valid trace count below 190 per task is a hard stop for task/global v2 pass.
Eligible span count below 150 per task is a hard stop for task/global v2 pass.
Nonzero Delta-U count below 20 per task is insufficient_target_variation.
API drift not logged and disclosed is a hard stop.
Missing required baselines in the same table blocks v2 pass wording.
No PRM/filtering claim is allowed without GLOBAL_S_FMA_V2_PASS or a separate downstream validation gate.

budget_recommendation.worth_requesting_budget_now: not for execution while STOP_AND_FIX_PREFLIGHT remains active
budget_recommendation.recommended_budget_strategy: If the user later chooses the stochastic route despite disclosed drift, request a staged budget: minimal smoke first, then pilot only if replay agreement and nonzero Delta-U look viable, then top-tier candidate only after pilot gates justify the risk.
budget_recommendation.do_not_request: Do not request or spend a top-tier budget as approval from this audit alone.
